description: When Mailbox/query is called with filter={parentId:null}, the intent is to return only top-level mailboxes (parentId == null). But the MailboxFilterCondition parent_id field is Option<Id>, so JSON null parses as None (absent), and the filter is not applied — all mailboxes including children are returned. Fix: distinguish between absent parentId (don't filter) and explicit parentId:null (filter to top-level only). This likely requires a Clearable<Id> or similar wrapper. Oracle: RFC 8621 §2.3, jmap-test-suite mailbox-query.test.ts.
title: jmap-mail-server: Mailbox/query parentId:null filter not applied
